South Africa Butlers Academy investigated

By: Michael Duffett | Delivery

Proposal


Show:

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Is that what it seems

Unique Selling Point:
SABA boasts that it's the largest academy in the world. its owned by a married couple Newton Cross 38 and Braam West who heads up a recruitment agency. Videos and pics show Cross training in various hotels around the world, the the website is full of claims about the academy and the owners themselves. But there are many many disgruntled ex students who feel that their training was inadequate and there are concerns that the place is pacing dummy job ads and they only way you can apply for these jobs is to do the actual SABA training at R35 000 a pop.

Summary:
One person is gunning for them - a professional lady from Singapore who decided she wanted a change in career - she wanted to open hotels and decided to do their course, after reading about them on their website. She concentrated on the chinese section of the website because she is fluent in Chinese and Mandarin. She left SABA after just two days - the second day she was told to go home because she came late. Angry because she had been overcharged 200 per cent on her fees, she set about researching SABA, and she has taken them to the High Court. She has many examples of how SABA has made false claims...she got in touch with previous students who all spoke about how poor their training was.she discovered that they place ads saying for example, Butler needed - R40 000.. but to qualify you need to do their course. An attorney I spoke to said that this was not legal/. She also discovered that students are bound to them for a year after completing the course. if they find a job, they have to go notify SABA's recruitment agency, who then takes a finder fee from the client. if they don't then the student is liable for that finders fee and legal action can follow. Again the attorney questions this.

Further information:
AJ Smith is a massively qualified butler, having worked for sheiks, royal families, lord's and families. Has international butler certificates. Overseen several properties of the sheiks. Flown around the world with them in private jets. He saw one of their adverts and applied. They told him that he had to do their course. AJ discovered that the AD they placed which had a picture of the house where the butler would work was actually a house in LA...USA. he reported this to GUMTREE who then took the ad down.

I will be having a conversation with a Jacques who lives in Vietnam - who was a student and who worked in the recruitment agency of SABA. he has the full blow down and he will say the ads were fake.

Then there is Mariche, who works now as a butler who went through their course.. She will say how shocking the course was - many of the aspects of being a butler, were not taught..and she will say so. She passed with full honours, they were impressed with her and even got her to train staff at some mansion in Namibia in the last 2 weeks of her course. Yet after the course, when she applied to one of their ADS, she was told that she was not qualified enough!!! Then there is Alberto, from Mozambique who will say shocking things about SABA and that their certificate is not recognised. Then there is Surie, who five years ago, trained there and she can talk on how abusive it was.

But one kingpin case study is Chris von Umenstein who is a feared blogger in Cape Town - she does restaurant reviews....she is cutting - also has written 3 books under the name SWITCHBITCH. Don't mess with her. She employed one of SABA's staff and was not happy with the student. She gave the academy the raspberry award. Instead of leaving it, the SABA decided to devote a web page thrashing her. Well of course Chris responded with a cutting article on them - and many ex students added to the article saying what a terrible place SABA was.Now when you search for butler academy in cape Town, Chris's cutting blog appears on the same google page.

There are 4 legal aspects underpinning this story.
There is Yang's high court case.
!0 students have taken SABA to the national consumer commission.
SABA took Chris to the High court and lost.
Another butler took SABA to court for defamation and won.

LINK: If you had the dream of becoming a professional butler wouldn't you like to be trained by a man who has worked for world leaders top international celebrities. well there is an academy in the cape headed up by a man who claims to have those credentials.

Newton - you must be able to mow the lawn, able to cut hair, cook the food, manage the household-

VO: The academy's website peaked the interest of Singaporean corporate executive Lin Yang who was holidaying in the cape in 2018. The academy runs an 8 week training course costing R35 000 upon which they receive this butler certificate. Cross often travels abroad to provide on site training to staff at hotels and resorts.

Derek: why did you want to go to a butler academy?
Yang: because I had a dream that when `i retire maybe when I retire

VO: In May 2019, on her third day at the academy's school , Yang was sent home after a dispute over punctuality.


Yang: They said, yang go home, you late - in a very serious tone...

VO: An incensed Yang , who had already started to have misgivings about the academy did not return. Instead she began investigating it and thats when she came across a public spat it had with a blogger in 2013.

LINK: It's probably never a good idea to pick a fight with a fiery Captonian who writes restaurants reviews under the name of whale tales blog – she is not known for holding back on her opinions.

VO: In fact Chris Von Ulmenstein who once owned a pr company and a number of guest houses is (reportedly) banned from some restaurants. She said that she employed a person who was an ex student of the academy to assist her with her guest house.

Chris: so `i thought that she would know everything... she would be the bees' knees – I felt so lucky I had found such a person - she lasted four days.


The woman, who Von Ulmstein said WAS NOT UP TO SCRATCH walked out, ... matters escalated.. Von Ulmstein (she) gave the academy a sour service award. In response, it posted the former employee’s version of events at the guest house on their website, titled 4 Days of Hell. Von Ulmenstein then have gave her version in a scathing blog post on the academy.

(Von umnebstien\'s version app;eared on her scatching blog post on the academy.)

Braam: We have never met with this lady that is opinionated of us – to see for her4selkf – do an interview -

Almost four years later, and the academy failed at the High Court to have the blog removed. Each party had to pay their own costs, that didn't Phase vonulmenbstien...

ChrisInterview: I was prepared to pay that..for the honour of my word etc

VO: In August Yang instituted a civil suit against the academy and Cross claiming a full refund and damages for using her picture on it's Facebook PAGE. She said she paid double what the local students paid.

VO: The academy say Yang actually received a reduced rate, as international students fees are normally three times more than the local student rate.

VO: In her affidavit Yang alleges many examples of misrepresentation. For example she read that Cross had trained at the Royal Butler School of Buckingham Palace. But extensive searches have not revealed its existence.


Yang : it is a claim, a gigantic blown out, you know... its very audacious to make such a claim -

Derek: You made a claim that you trained at the Royal butler school at Buckingham palace.

Newton: So we going to leave that for the court, its subjudice, and we will provide the evidence and proof for that.

Derek: Now the big claim...that you provided butler services for xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx and John Cleese!

Newton: Absolutely, and it was amazing.

I VO : it turned out that Cross was hired to provide butler services at fan court where these leaders and SOME of these celebrities stayed during the 2003 President’s world cup…

(Derek: Newton, don't you see that that claims could be interpreted as you having been personal butlers to these people for long periods?

Newton; Derek, on your website, website, I think I even read on your website that you worked for Top Sport , like you have, we mentioned this because this because it was the highlight of our career....

Derek: But I worked for top sport for a long time, I didn't just pop into the studio for a day...

Newton: No I didn't just do it for a day...(laughs)
(derek noddy)

Newton: I never claimed that I was a butler to these individuals, I said that buttled for these individuals.

VO: Yang is not happy that her PICTURES still appear on the acadmeby's face book page.

CROSS: WE ASK PERMISSION FOR OUT STUDENTS TO PLACE PICS ON SOCIAL MEDIA AND SHE FUL HEARTEDLY AGREED SO.

Yang denies this and Said she's sent letters of demand to have them removed.

DEREK: WELL WHY DON'T YOU JUST REMOVE THEM?

CROSS: WE CAN REMOVE THEM AT ANY POINT IN TIME BUT AS I SAY WE WILL LEAVE THIS AS WE GO TO OUR LEGAL PROCEEDINGS FOR THE COURT AND SUB JUDICE.

VO: Cross further denied all Yang’s allegations saying they’ll answer in court, but stated that her version is subjective and vexatious.

VO: But Yang had contacted former academy students many of whom had complaints, like this former Cum Lauda academy graduate who preferred not to be identified.

Student: At first it was really nice because we were told about these exciting topics we were going to learn:

VO: The certificate she received lists many skills she would be proficient in but the former student said that the training was skimpy. (below par )

CIGAR ALLEGATION

Derek: What about cigar presentation...?
Student: Cigar presentation, we read through two pages on how to care for cigars...
we were not shown how to clip, them, just told how to, and how to light them.

Derek: Cigar presentation – read through 2 pages, not shown how to clip them.

Cross: No no, not at all, here we even have online training... we have lut cigar training – beautiful, amazing.

FLOWERS ALLEGATION

Derekand flower arranging?

Student: Flower arranging, we never did, nothing.

Derek: Flower arranging, nothing...

Cross: Behind you, behind you.

VO: When we arrived we did see Cross providing flower training.

MIXOLOGY ALLEGATION

Derek: What is mixology, I should know..

Student: its the mixing of drinks...

Derek: ah, that should be an extensive part of the course..

Student: yes.. we were taught how to make a bloody mary, and a martini -

Derek: That's it?

Student: That's it!

Derek – and cocktail training.....

Cross: Oh lovely, we love to train mixology...we will teach you how to do the...

Derek: A bloody Mary and a martini, and that's it...that's not enough is it?

Braam: Those are the basics, `I wish you could bring that lady here...because its easy to speak to you.

Derek: 2 cocktails...

Braam: def more than that....

ACCREDIATION ALLEGATION

Yang read on the Chinese version of the academy's website that it's certificate was recognised by our local trade association for hospitality – Fedhasa but this is not the case. Cross said that the academy had once been a member only of Fedhasa – and that a translation error had occurred.

Cross: That was pointed out a few weeks ago, with miss Yang, that did the translation, and that is something that we removed?

But the English brochure Yang received also made this claim.

Cross: I think something has gone between the lines, but we do not advertise...we are private and we cannot be accredited in silverware. Housekeeping.

Their current brochure makes no mention of Fehasa



Now The Academy claims to provide an international certificate but a former student said that his certificate was not recognised. The academy said they WERE recognised by clients from countries outside SA and most countries where there is a market for qualified butlers".

In the meantime, Yang and 9 students of 5 different nationalities registered a complaint at the national Consumer Commission and have all submitted affidavits with similar complaints, which the National Consumer Commission is assessing. The academy said that they were not aware of the complaint and believe that this was another vindictive action that will come to nothing.

Derek: yang, the academy claims that you have a vendetta against them...that you and you are trying to collect every shred of evidence

Yang: because I cant just say, hey, they are quack. I have to do my search to prove my allegations.

And she has spent 18 months doing that. spent over a year. In the meantime the academy says that they have had 748 students enrolled in its 8 week courses, and estimated that they have trained roughly 1440 aspiring butlers.

Cross: `it's about me and my students - and what we could do to give them the opportunities which we had - for 11 years and it makes my heart warm, and there are many that have passed though our doors.

ACCREDIATION ALLEGATION Yang read on the Chinese version of the academy's website that it's certificate was recognised by our local trade association for hospitality – Fedhasa but this is not the case. Cross said that the academy had once been a member only of Fedhasa – and that a translation error had occurred. Cross: That was pointed out a few weeks ago, with miss Yang, that did the translation, and that is something that we removed? But the English brochure Yang received also made this claim. Cross: I think something has gone between the lines, but we do not advertise...we are private and we cannot be accredited in silverware. Housekeeping. Their current brochure makes no mention of Fehasa Now The Academy claims to provide an international certificate but a former student said that his certificate was not recognised. The academy said they WERE recognised by clients from countries outside SA and most countries where there is a market for qualified butlers". In the meantime, Yang and 9 students of 5 different nationalities registered a complaint at the national Consumer Commission and have all submitted affidavits with similar complaints, which the National Consumer Commission is assessing. The academy said that they were not aware of the complaint and believe that this was another vindictive action that will come to nothing. Derek: yang, the academy claims that you have a vendetta against them...that you and you are trying to collect every shred of evidence Yang: because I cant just say, hey, they are quack. I have to do my search to prove my allegations. And she has spent 18 months doing that. spent over a year. In the meantime the academy says that they have had 748 students enrolled in its 8 week courses, and estimated that they have trained roughly 1440 aspiring butlers. Cross: `it's about me and my students - and what we could do to give them the opportunities which we had - for 11 years and it makes my heart warm, and there are many that have passed though our doors.

metadata.Unique Selling Point: SABA boasts that it's the largest academy in the world. its owned by a married couple Newton Cross 38 and Braam West who heads up a recruitment agency. Videos and pics show Cross training in various hotels around the world, the the website is full of claims about the academy and the owners themselves. But there are many many disgruntled ex students who feel that their training was inadequate and there are concerns that the place is pacing dummy job ads and they only way you can apply for these jobs is to do the actual SABA training at R35 000 a pop.
metadata.Summary: One person is gunning for them - a professional lady from Singapore who decided she wanted a change in career - she wanted to open hotels and decided to do their course, after reading about them on their website. She concentrated on the chinese section of the website because she is fluent in Chinese and Mandarin. She left SABA after just two days - the second day she was told to go home because she came late. Angry because she had been overcharged 200 per cent on her fees, she set about researching SABA, and she has taken them to the High Court. She has many examples of how SABA has made false claims...she got in touch with previous students who all spoke about how poor their training was.she discovered that they place ads saying for example, Butler needed - R40 000.. but to qualify you need to do their course. An attorney I spoke to said that this was not legal/. She also discovered that students are bound to them for a year after completing the course. if they find a job, they have to go notify SABA's recruitment agency, who then takes a finder fee from the client. if they don't then the student is liable for that finders fee and legal action can follow. Again the attorney questions this.
metadata.Further information: AJ Smith is a massively qualified butler, having worked for sheiks, royal families, lord's and families. Has international butler certificates. Overseen several properties of the sheiks. Flown around the world with them in private jets. He saw one of their adverts and applied. They told him that he had to do their course. AJ discovered that the AD they placed which had a picture of the house where the butler would work was actually a house in LA...USA. he reported this to GUMTREE who then took the ad down. I will be having a conversation with a Jacques who lives in Vietnam - who was a student and who worked in the recruitment agency of SABA. he has the full blow down and he will say the ads were fake. Then there is Mariche, who works now as a butler who went through their course.. She will say how shocking the course was - many of the aspects of being a butler, were not taught..and she will say so. She passed with full honours, they were impressed with her and even got her to train staff at some mansion in Namibia in the last 2 weeks of her course. Yet after the course, when she applied to one of their ADS, she was told that she was not qualified enough!!! Then there is Alberto, from Mozambique who will say shocking things about SABA and that their certificate is not recognised. Then there is Surie, who five years ago, trained there and she can talk on how abusive it was. But one kingpin case study is Chris von Umenstein who is a feared blogger in Cape Town - she does restaurant reviews....she is cutting - also has written 3 books under the name SWITCHBITCH. Don't mess with her. She employed one of SABA's staff and was not happy with the student. She gave the academy the raspberry award. Instead of leaving it, the SABA decided to devote a web page thrashing her. Well of course Chris responded with a cutting article on them - and many ex students added to the article saying what a terrible place SABA was.Now when you search for butler academy in cape Town, Chris's cutting blog appears on the same google page. There are 4 legal aspects underpinning this story. There is Yang's high court case. !0 students have taken SABA to the national consumer commission. SABA took Chris to the High court and lost. Another butler took SABA to court for defamation and won.
